base_member_text: 교차라인 의미 결함 후보: DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH 비CARTESIAN 판의 마지막 스텐실 항이 -Uin(I+2,J+2) (L407) — CARTESIAN 판 L404 및 y 방향 대칭 스텐실 상 -Uin(I,J+2) 이어야 할 자리로, I+2 는 오타로 보이는 불일치(원문 그대로 기록)
audit_member_text: Non-CARTESIAN DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH has a cross-axis stencil mismatch: its first four terms at L406-L407 keep x index I and vary J, but the final positive-side term is Uin(I+2,J+2) at L407. The CARTESIAN branch uses Uin(I,J+2) at L403-L404. This changes the nominal yy stencil by adding an x offset only in the non-CARTESIAN branch and is consistent with a copy/paste defect.

base_member_text: tmp1..tmp4 (DERIVATIVE_XY L242-248, DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH L315-334)는 이 파일에 선언 없음 — USE PARAM 모듈 소재 전역 임시변수로 추정되나 이 파일만으로 미확정
audit_member_text: Every subroutine enables IMPLICIT NONE (L53, L89, L124, L159, L193, L228, L265, L301, L353, L389) but none locally declares loop indices I and J used from L64 onward. DERIVATIVE_XY additionally uses tmp1/tmp2 at L242-L248 without local declarations, and DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH uses tmp1/tmp2/tmp3/tmp4 at L315-L335 without local declarations. The file's USE PARAM statements may supply these names; if they do not, compilation fails, while if they do, the loop/scratch state is use-associated rather than local and reentrancy/thread-safety depends on PARAM. That dependency cannot be resolved from this file.

루프 변수 I,J 도 이 파일 내 선언 없음(IMPLICIT NONE 하에서) — USE PARAM 제공으로 추정

audit_member_text: The higher-order routines access Uin at offsets up to plus/minus two (L67-L71, L103-L107, L315-L335, L368-L372, L403-L407), but their loops accept arbitrary Ibeg:Iend and Jbeg:Jend without checking a two-cell halo. The required caller-side bounds contract is not declared here.

Comments label DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH, DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH, and DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH as fourth derivatives at L293, L345, and L381, while the implemented denominators and five-point coefficients at L315-L335, L368-L372, and L403-L407 form wider approximations of mixed/second derivatives. Whether '4th-derivative' was intended to mean fourth-order accuracy is not stated.

For non-CARTESIAN spacing, all stencils divide a uniform-grid difference formula by only the center-cell DX(I,J) and/or DY(I,J) (for example L70-L71, L211-L212, L246-L248, L327-L336); only DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH explicitly documents a locally constant-spacing assumption at L326. Applicability on materially varying grids is not specified.
